list: Official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 Nov 2026 (cross-checked with TrueAchievements by planetgta6.com). Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; the guides are this app's own words.
sources: PlayStation official trophy list, via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
planetgta6.com — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements, 18 Nov 2026
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, 19 Nov 2026
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, 19 Nov 2026

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, strangers second, then the world, the activities and the money, and finish with 100% completion. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end — this is the first story trophy and it unlocks naturally, it cannot be missed. It is hidden on PlayStation until you earn it, so the spoiler setting in this guide keeps it covered until then. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude — launch-day reporting says that spot is only reachable in Chapter 1 (Output Lag; KeenGamer). Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: there is no mission replay (Output Lag). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — no mission replay; Chapter 1 meditation spot
KeenGamer — roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. This is where both protagonists become playable and most of the open-world list opens up, so after the chapter ends is the best time to start the collectibles in Phase 3. The asterisks are in the name as PlayStation publishes it. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep your chapter-start manual save habit going — with no mission replay, a save at the top of each chapter is your only way back to anything chapter-gated (Output Lag). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — no mission replay

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Before the final mission, make a separate manual save — the ending choice trophy (Actions Speak Louder) and the finale itself sit behind it, and there is no mission replay to redo them (Output Lag). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — no mission replay

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It is one of only two gold trophies, and it closes Phase 1 of the roadmap — everything after it is open-world cleanup you can do at your own pace. Save before the finale so the ending choice can be revisited. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one unlock by playing the story through — no extra objective is needed, just finish the mission. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in the story are one-offs, so play them when they come and let the trophy pop on completion — there is no replay to come back to (Output Lag). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — no mission replay

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks on completion with no side objective — follow the story and it comes to you. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. No extra objective: finish the mission and the trophy unlocks. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. It pairs with the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, which is also set at VCIA — do that one after the story, when you can move around the airport freely. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story-completion trophy: finish the mission, no extra objective. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist — the second gold trophy and the last one before the platinum. Rockstar has not published what the 100% checklist covers (planetgta6, 18 Nov 2026), but the visible trophies map it closely: story, the 8 stranger strands, the collectibles (WAiNK at 100 spots, 100 vehicles, 3 card sets, every meditation spot), the activities (250 stunts, 20 races, shooting-range gold, 50 challenges) and exploring all of Leonida. Clear the other 53 trophies first and 100% should be nearly done. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
planetgta6.com — 100% contents unpublished; visible trophies map the workload

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the like, as the game counts them. This is a grind trophy, not a skill one: fold stunts into every drive instead of farming them at the end, and the counter climbs while you do everything else. Track it here; the in-game stats page shows the running count. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game once — one race, one shooting-range challenge, one arcade game, one fishing spot, one drone race, and so on. It is a taster trophy: play one of each and it pops, and it naturally leads into the deeper activity trophies (The Shootist, Earn Cash Not Kudos, Top Fun). The full list of activity types is whatever the in-game activities menu shows. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge — PlayStation tracks 42 of them. Learn each range's weapon and target pattern, and retry a challenge on the spot until gold lands; ranges can be replayed freely, so nothing here is missable. Do it after the story, when you own the full weapon set. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations around Leonida. Visit every drone-race spot on the map and win once at each — the trophy is about coverage, not speed, so learn one clean line per course and repeat it. Races stay available after the story. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida: street, off-road and water races all count as long as each event is a different one. Pick a fast, stable car per surface and keep a note of which events you have won; this tracker does the noting for you. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities you sample for Master of None — find Cal's fishing challenge, learn the reeling rhythm, and out-fish him in a single challenge. One win is all it takes. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at any arcade in Leonida. Pick the shortest game on the machine and play it through — one completion pops the trophy. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and meet people across Leonida — take Andy's missions whenever his marker appears, and the strand ends with this trophy. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Work his missions in order as they appear; the strand's last mission is the one that pops this trophy. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Billy's missions are biker-flavoured — keep a fast bike handy for his strand. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands. Five strands have their own trophies — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus Bret's hunt (Fair Game), so those six get you most of the way; find two more strangers out in the world to reach eight. Strands appear as you explore, so sweep the map regions you have not visited. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Take his missions as they appear and see the strand through to its end. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Like the other stranger strands, it unlocks by meeting Tyrone in the world and working his missions in order. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 spots, per KeenGamer's launch-day roadmap. THIS IS THE ONE REPORTED MISSABLE TROPHY: a meditation spot on Lucia's balcony is only reachable during Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay (Output Lag; KeenGamer). Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, then sweep the remaining spots after the story. If you already passed Chapter 1 without it, your only fix is a Chapter 1 manual save or a new playthrough — which is why this guide puts a save reminder at the top of Phase 1. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — Chapter 1 spot only reachable in Chapter 1; no mission replay
KeenGamer — 18 meditation spots

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — one of his stranger-strand hunts. Track the animal Bret asks for, take it down cleanly, and bring the result back to him. It also counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, in the world and as activity rewards. Collect a whole set, then two more; the in-game collection screen shows which cards each set is still missing. Sweep one region at a time and tick sets off here. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo/share feature — open it at landmarks, viewpoints and street scenes all over Leonida and the counter climbs. Fold it into your exploration for The Goodtime State: every new region you visit is a few more WAiNK spots. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's checklist of small feats across driving, combat, exploration and activities. Open the challenges menu early and let it steer your free-roam time: most challenges complete themselves while you chase the other trophies, and the last few are worth targeting deliberately. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Plan the escape before you start the heat: a fast car, a route out of the search area, and a hiding spot. Losing the wanted level with your partner still with you is what pops it. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Pick three shops close together, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving — the trick is keeping the wanted level alive across all three robberies instead of escaping after each one. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — sit in or drive each one and the game logs it. Leonida's roads, car parks and dealerships are the hunting ground; rare spawns turn up in specific districts, so vary where you drive. Pair it with On the Spot: register the best 10 you find to the Scooter Bros app. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Find a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff — trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it runs out. A high-capacity weapon and a tight group of enemies make it far easier. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get into a plane at Vice City International and take off without following the usual script; the description is the whole official clue. Try it after the story, when the airport is open to you. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description's only clue is its joke — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — which points at the Rhino tank. Get into a Rhino and use it until the trophy pops; the exact trigger is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag lists this among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method, 19 Nov 2026). Try driving it into trouble and surviving the heat. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go quiet: case the store, wait for a moment with no eyes on you, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, walk away and try again — a failed attempt costs nothing but time. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault robberies are the biggest heists in the free-roam list — plan the getaway before you go in, and count each clean escape here. Five vaults, five escapes. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and get clear before the response arrives. A nod to the classic GTA V blitz play, and the easiest of the robbery trophies. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida — the map fills in as you visit each area. Drive the highways end to end, visit the Keys, the swamps, the cities and the coast, and watch the map's fog lift. Doing this early also feeds Whip It Good, You WAiNKer! and the meditation spots. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs its own off-books spots — find one per gang, hit it, and get out. The map's gang territories are the guide: one robbery per gang, not one per spot. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take it in with the view — the description is the whole official clue, and the unlock method is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag, 19 Nov 2026). A quiet moment trophy: do it while you are exploring the beach for The Goodtime State. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car, and go through the window; the description is the official clue and the method is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag, 19 Nov 2026). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — bowl a game there. The description points at the alley itself; play a full game of bowling and the trophy should follow. The exact trigger is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag, 19 Nov 2026). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the description is a riddle, and the unlock method is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag, 19 Nov 2026). The wording points at doing something notable together with your partner, in front of a crowd. Try partner activities that draw an audience; check the community guides (PSNProfiles, PowerPyx) once hunters pin the trigger down, and do not trust an unconfirmed method. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the story's big choice — the description, 'Choices made (for better or worse)', points at a decision point in the story, most likely at the finale. Keep a manual save before the final mission so you can see the choice through and, if the ending branches, revisit it; there is no mission replay (Output Lag). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — no mission replay

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the description says it all: fail at something, then succeed on the second try. The exact trigger is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag, 19 Nov 2026); the likely shape is retrying a failed activity or challenge and clearing it on the next attempt. If it does not pop on its own while you play, retry a failed race or challenge deliberately. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the description is a joke about a strange encounter, and the unlock method is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag, 19 Nov 2026). The name is a nod to UFO lore, so keep an eye out for something unexplained while exploring Leonida at night, and check PSNProfiles once hunters report the trigger. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock down a group of people with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, like bowling pins. Line up a slow drive-by past a group on foot and swing; the description is the official clue and the method is not confirmed at launch (Output Lag, 19 Nov 2026). Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Output Lag — unlock method unconfirmed at launch

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations — and your contacts wash them into clean cash. Run the robbery trophies first (Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play, Pest Control) and the bills pile up; launder them steadily instead of hoarding. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything with a price tag. It counts total spending across every shop, so buy what you actually want as you play and top up with big-ticket items (a car, a weapon set) near the end. Do it after the laundering in Dime on the Dollar, when the clean cash is there. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought from the in-game property listings — visit each one, pay up, and the trophy pops when the last is yours. Save it for Phase 5, when robbery money and laundered cash make the prices painless. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten vehicles you like while hunting Whip It Good's 100 discoveries, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — ten registrations pops it. Source: official description, PlayStation via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026).
sources: Official description — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
